records.text: Bassem Youssef said Breaking the Silence is a group of former IDF soldiers who describe atrocities and behind-the-scenes operations in Gaza and the West Bank.
records.speaker: Bassem Youssef

appearances.snippet: breaking the silence which is like the group of the idf soldiers who they have a movement called breaking the silence ex-idf soldiers who speaks about the atrocities that they did and then now they come up and and saying like what what happened behind the scenes of their operations in Gaza and West Bank

verification.notes: Breaking the Silence describes itself as an organization of veteran Israeli soldiers that publishes researched testimonies about military service and firsthand actions in the West Bank, Gaza, and East Jerusalem. Its materials discuss abuse, destruction, violence, orders, and operations. That confirms the group's identity and core activity; 'atrocities that they did' is Youssef's broader characterization rather than the organization's uniform description of every testimony.

sources.title: Breaking the Silence: The Organization
sources.relevance: Officially describes the organization, its veteran-soldier membership, and its testimony work in the occupied territories.

sources.title: Breaking the Silence questions and answers
sources.relevance: Explains that former soldiers publish verified firsthand accounts of their service in the West Bank and Gaza.
